zh: 原创潮玩角色，一只墨绿软胶矮梯形身和一枚高大圆按钮长在一起：整枚按钮就是它的头和脸壳，拿掉按钮就没有角色。头直径大于身宽，钮面中央比边缘低一格，还没有按到底，钮面没有文字和图标。略睁的小黑豆眼贴在钮面下沿，极小一字嘴，表情淡。身体微微前倾，两枚短钝足站稳，像按到一半停住。主体是墨绿软胶，只有按钮顶面是厚瓷釉白，下陷边缘一条芥末黄。配色是墨绿配瓷釉白，加一点芥末黄。单个角色完整全身，正面略侧，站在浅灰纯色背景前，柔和棚拍光，像真实的搪胶毛绒或手办产品照。不要儿童绘本或涂色书风格，不要卡通吉祥物，不要闪亮的动漫大眼，不要穿衣服的人类小孩造型，不要奔跑、跳跃或任何动作场景，不要速度线，不要细长的橡皮管式手脚，不要细长的手指，不要张嘴大笑，不要多余的饰品和细节，不要背景物件。不要真人脸发型服装，不要明星姓名，不要现有潮玩或品牌名，不要疾病、伤口或残缺造型，不要整体透明果冻身体。不要把按钮画成墙上的开关，不要按到底，不要文字图标，不要游戏界面，不要发光指示灯，不要弹跳。
enp: Original designer toy character: a dark-green soft-rubber trapezoid body fused with a tall round button — the button is the head and face shell, without it there is no character. The head is wider than the body; the button face sits one step lower than its rim, not fully depressed, with no text or icons. Slightly open tiny black bean eyes sit on the lower edge of the face, a tiny straight mouth, expression calm. The body leans slightly forward, two short blunt feet planted, as if paused halfway through a press. Body is dark-green soft rubber; only the button top is thick white glaze, with a mustard-yellow crease. Colors: dark green with glazed white and a mustard edge. Single character, full body, slight three-quarter front view, standing on a plain light grey background, soft studio lighting, looks like a real vinyl-plush or figure product photo. No children's book or coloring page style, no cartoon mascot, no big shiny anime eyes, no clothed human child figure, no running, jumping or action scene, no speed lines, no thin rubber-hose limbs, no thin long fingers, no wide open-mouth grin, no extra accessories or details, no background props. No real person's face, hairstyle or clothing, no celebrity names, no existing toy or brand names, no disease, wounds or disfigurement, no fully transparent jelly body. No wall switch, no fully depressed button, no text or icons, no game UI, no indicator light, no bouncing.
